title: Those Who Meditate On The True One
summary: Self-Worth is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
takeaway: Those who meditate on the True One are attuned to Truth
lifeApplication: Let dignity be received before it is defended. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.

source.shortMeaning: Those who meditate on the True One are attuned to Truth
source.lifeApplication: Let dignity be received before it is defended. Let the line meet the ordinary room before self-judgment starts arranging it.
